fixes.explanation: Ooh, not quite, friend. Picture a group chat where every leader votes on the departure time. That's not what happened here. The text says Israel set out "…according to the LORD’s command through Moses." (Numbers 10:13) The command came from the LORD, and the tribe leaders just got the memo. I bet they packed fast.

Shur is a decent guess, friend, but the verse points somewhere else. Numbers 10:12 says the cloud settled "…in the Wilderness of Paran." Israel goes from place to place first, and then the cloud settles. Nobody in that camp gets to say "are we there yet" and be right.

problems.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.
The passage says the cloud settled in Paran, but it does not say the cloud decided when the trip stopped.
